decisions.reason: The multi-layer end-to-end security architecture underpins the integrated platform and the move toward a broader secure ecosystem, even if it is no longer marketed under its own name.

The email-to-app delivery robot is a niche feature that has disappeared from the website, and in-app secure messaging within the ecosystem now covers its purpose, so its resources are better used in core development.
The QR hardware token still serves banking customers who need PSD2-compliant transaction authorization without a smartphone, and it fits the firm's existing hardware line.
Payment network security compliance stays relevant for regulated customers and builds directly on the firm's cryptography expertise, despite its low visibility on the website.
